# HexPiece 3.6.7

Your three Mochi notes. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and the trident was rendered in previews.

## The trident (Awakening)
Your words: "Trident in the awakening should not be held at the tip of the rod it it should be in the middle of the hand and should
disappear when not using M1s, and manist from a mochi only when using M1s."
- Mogura is now gripped at the middle of its shaft.
- It is only in your hand while you swing it: on your first left click it forms out of a wrap of mochi in your hand (the dough peels
  away from it in a moment), it stays while you keep swinging, and about half a second after your last swing it goes back into mochi
  and is gone.

## No impact frames
Your words: "I want 0 impact frames in this fruit, IMPACT FRAMES ARE ONLY FOR CLASHES."
Buzz Cut Mochi (and Scorching Buzz Cut) no longer show any impact frame, for you or for the ones caught. No other Mochi move had one.

## Buzz Cut Mochi is not a cutscene any more
Your words: "Buzz Cut Mochi is no longer a cutscene, you can look around, but the camera adapts to the height of the vertical lift of the
move, the hit player(s) dont get any special camera."
- Your view is never taken over: you look around freely, and the game no longer switches you into third person.
- In third person your camera pulls back and rises as the arm lifts the giant ball up high, so the lift stays in view, and comes back
  down with it.
- The ones caught keep their own camera.
- Your body still turns with the whirling arm, and you stay where you caught them.

Your note's item 4 arrived empty: send it again and it comes next. The Phoenix fruit is being built after this.
